'''Kaadu''' were large, flightless [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavians]] that inhabited the [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Obredaan]] as well as the moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] frequently used them as mounts.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Kaadu-wosfg.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Male and female with young]]
The kaadu was a two-legged reptavian at home both on land and in the [[Water/Legends|water]]: they were excellent runners and strong swimmers, as their lung capacity allowed them to remain underwater for up to two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name=":0">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> Kaadu came in shades of [[Color/Legends|yellow]] and bright oranges. The area around their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] was a periwinkle color.<ref name=":1" />

Kaadu had sharp hearing and a keen sense of smell.<ref name=":2" /> They lacked upper incisors, and as such were unable to chew their food. Their diet consisted primarily of [[Snail/Legends|snails]], [[tlickweed]], and standard aquatic plants. Their blunt, hoof-like claws provided surefootedness. The stub tail counterbalanced the head.<ref name=":0" />

They could be found in huge, sexually segregated flocks (20&ndash;100 individuals on average), with the total record documented as 3.4 million individuals. Male flocks and female flocks came together during mating, at which time the males became more colorful with yellows and purples. They often had close familial ties. Kaadu females laid their eggs on land, often in fields, but also on riverbanks, where they made elevated mud nests that they lined with vegetable matter. Because predators such as the [[Peko-peko/Legends|peko-peko]] ate unattended kaadu eggs, the average clutch of eggs was usually 10 to 12 at a time. Six to eight in a clutch would usually make it to hatching. The young were fully precocial at hatching.<ref name=":0" />

Predators of the adults included [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatches]] and [[Zalaaca/Legends|zalaacas]].<ref name=":0" />

Kaadu meat was comestible. The cookbook ''[[Essential Cooking Skills]]'' detailed how to best cook that meat.<ref name="SWG:ECS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|ESSENTIAL COOKING SKILLS}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:Kaadu_Cavalry_SECR.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A Gungan of the Kaadu Cavalry on his kaadu mount]]
The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] long ago domesticated the kaadu.<ref name=":2" /> Kaadu were known to be fearless, and many were domesticated by Gungan warriors as steeds during times of conflict, or as patrol animals to police the Gungan [[City/Legends|cities]]. Kaadu were highly loyal to their owners; it was said that a Gungan and his kaadu made an inseparable team. Warriors often decorated their steeds with huge [[titavian]] feathers.<ref name=":0" /> [[Officer/Legends|Officers]] of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] rode into [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle]] against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] upon their kaadu mounts.<ref name=":1">{{Film|I}}</ref>

They were also encountered by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during their [[Second mission to Obredaan|task]] of finding missing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] in the swamps of [[Obredaan]].<ref name="Star Wars: Obi-Wan video game">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The kaadu was originally developed as a beast of burden on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']]. The creature was later given more aquatic characteristics and transferred to Naboo. The kaadu seen in Episode I are computer-generated models. They run with a hopping trot that moves them briskly across the battlefield.<ref name=":2">{{DB|creature|kaadu|kaadu}}</ref>

''[[Episode I Adventures 15: The Final Battle]]'' erroneously describes the kaadu as a four-legged creature.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 15: The Final Battle">''[[Episode I Adventures 15: The Final Battle]]''</ref>

The sound for the kaadu was created from the slowed-down sound of pigs and the sound of the blowhole of a whale.<ref name="Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-present-familiar-creatures-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>
